title: Add native live Control bridge center
summary: Turn the native Control readiness page into a live bridge center for Studio, Control, and app workspaces: endpoint discovery, live/fallback status, HumbleSudoku loading, missing-export recovery, connection center, deep-link map, no-write edit preview, locked apply contract, status checks, and first end-to-end safe-edit flow.
acceptance_criteria: The native Control readiness page shows whether HumbleControl is live or the native fallback is active.
The page exposes an app connection center for the accepted ten app lanes and lets HumbleSudoku load through the existing supported-app loader.
Missing local repository/export state is visible before loading, and load uses the existing generator-backed supported-app path when available.
The page includes native deep links, status checks, edit preview, locked apply contract, and end-to-end safe-edit flow without enabling source writes.
Native build and repository checks prove the new bridge center compiles and preserves the no-write contract.

evidence.note: Runtime discovery now tracks HumbleControl candidate origins, live/fallback mode, origin, attempts, and checked-at time.
The hero and status checks show whether the page is using a live Control endpoint or native fallback.
Control Readiness receives the existing supported-app loader so HumbleSudoku can be loaded from the bridge center.
The bridge uses the existing StudioShellModel.loadSupportedApp path, which resolves local HumbleSudoku export and runs the existing generator when the export is missing.
Connection center renders the first ten app lanes from the supported app catalog with native Load and Control-open actions.
Deep-link map, no-write edit preview, status checks, locked apply gate, and ten-step end-to-end safe-edit flow are now native sections.
